title: Congruence modules and Wiles defects of determinantal rings of maximal minors
summary: Let $O$ be a discrete valuation ring and $A := O[X_{m \times n}]/I_{m}(X)$ the determinantal ring of maximal minors. We consider algebra maps $λ\colon A \to O$, which is tantamount to choosing rank-deficient matrices $a \in O^{m \times n}$. Following Iyengar--Khare--Manning, we compute the congruence module and the Wiles defect of $A$ at $λ$, expressing them in terms of the $(m - 1)$-sized minors of $a$.
